item.title: Two Streams
item.description: Two tones, alternating: low, high, low, high. At slow rates, most listeners hear a single melody. Speed the alternation up, or widen the gap between the frequencies, and something shifts. The streams are what the inhibition settles into, not what anything chose. The simulation has no access to which state is active. The tones are identical. The difference is in you.
